description: SectionList is a performant React Native component used to render grouped or sectioned lists with headers, footers, separators, and advanced scrolling features.
whenToUse: When data is grouped into sections
When you need headers for each group

sections.description: Array of section objects containing data

renderItem.description: Function to render each item in a section

importantProps.name: renderSectionHeader
importantProps.description: Renders the header for each section

importantProps.name: renderSectionFooter
importantProps.description: Renders the footer for each section

importantProps.name: ListHeaderComponent
importantProps.description: Rendered at the top of the list

importantProps.name: ListFooterComponent
importantProps.description: Rendered at the bottom of the list

importantProps.name: keyExtractor
importantProps.description: Returns a unique key for each item

notes: extraData should be used if UI depends on external state
Offscreen items may unmount for performance

comparison.FlatList: Use when data is simple and not grouped
comparison.SectionList: Use when data needs grouping with headers
